decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8371. Series context: trend strength 0.027 and seasonal strength 0.1624; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.216); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.729.
